report_name: Old Bass River Daily Fishing Report
location: Bass River, Dennis & Yarmouth, Cape Cod
opening_note: Update this note each morning with what your own crew, customers, or trusted local contacts are actually seeing.

hot_spots.best_window: First light through early outgoing tide
hot_spots.notes: Moving water and bait tend to concentrate fish here. Topwater early, then soft plastics or jigs once the sun gets up.

hot_spots.zone: Nantucket Sound Rips East of Bass River
hot_spots.notes: Watch for birds, nervous water, and fast current seams. Good zone to update with live intel every day.

hot_spots.zone: South Side Beaches, West Dennis to Harwich
hot_spots.notes: Useful fallback when the river is slow or traffic is heavy. Look for bait and cleaner water.
